current_role: Majority owner of Las Vegas Sands and of the Dallas Mavericks; publisher of Israel Hayom; Republican megadonor
summary: Miriam Adelson is an Israeli-American physician specializing in addiction treatment and the widow of casino magnate Sheldon Adelson (died 2021); she controls Las Vegas Sands, bought a majority of the Dallas Mavericks with her family in 2023 and publishes the Israeli daily Israel Hayom. One of the largest Republican donors, she gave about $100 million to the pro-Trump super PAC Preserve America in 2024, and Trump awarded her the Presidential Medal of Freedom in 2018.

connections.name: Donald Trump
connections.description: Adelson is one of Trump's biggest backers: she and Sheldon Adelson gave about $90 million to the pro-Trump Preserve America PAC in 2020, and she gave about $100 million in 2024. Trump awarded her the Presidential Medal of Freedom in 2018; she co-hosted a 2025 inaugural ball; her family foundation gave $25 million toward his White House ballroom; he hailed her in his October 2025 Knesset speech; and in December 2025 she urged him to seek an unconstitutional third term, which he said came with an offer of "another $250 million".
